verdict.rationale: Simular documents running up to 5 cloud computers concurrently on Pay as you go, and replayable parameterized skills (e.g., invoice_export with vendor/month) that cut cost on repetitive tasks. Together these let it work through many similar items in parallel or repeatedly, but there is no explicit bulk-operation feature. missing for 10: a documented batch/bulk mode that applies one operation across many items in a single invocation, evidence of fanning a skill out over a list of inputs, scale or throughput details beyond 5 concurrent machines, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
